t: What he named as the least reliable speech there is
a: إِيَّاكُمْ وَالظَّنَّ، فَإِنَّ الظَّنَّ أَكْذَبُ الْحَدِيثِ، وَلاَ تَجَسَّسُوا، وَلاَ تَحَسَّسُوا، وَلاَ تَبَاغَضُوا، وَكُونُوا إِخْوَانًا
p: Iyyākum wa-ẓ-ẓann, fa-inna-ẓ-ẓanna akdhabu-l-ḥadīth. Wa lā tajassasū, wa lā taḥassasū, wa lā tabāghaḍū, wa kūnū ikhwānā
m: Beware of assumption, for assumption is the falsest speech. Do not spy, do not pry, do not hate one another. And be brothers.
